## About
iKon Collision is an auto body shop in Matthews, NC. Our mission is to keep your car on the road, with high quality repairs, exceptional service, and transparent pricing. We try to make the repair process as hassle-free as possible so you can get back on the road safely and with confidence.
You'll deal with real people here. Customers mention Josh, Arina and Juli by name for keeping them updated and making the process easy, and one customer got to talk shop with the owner, Paul, right on the floor.
We're rated 5 on Google from 189 reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Free Estimates: We look over your vehicle's damage and give you a cost projection for repairs, with no obligation or initial charge.
- Insurance Assistance: We guide you through the claim, talk with your provider, and make sure repairs are documented the way your provider requires.
- Bumper Repair: Cosmetic and structural repair, including bumper and paint repair after a collision.
- Paintless Dent Repair: We take out minor dents and dings without touching the original paint finish.
- Glass Replacement: We remove damaged glass, clean the area and install new glass to manufacturer's standards for safety and visibility.
- Vehicle Diagnostics & Calibration: Diagnostics and calibration as part of getting your vehicle back to right.
- Towing: If your vehicle can't be driven, we'll safely bring it to our shop for repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help streamline the repair process.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on the extent of the damage, the repairs needed and parts availability. We'll send you repair updates while your vehicle is with us.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: That depends on the damage, the parts and materials, and the labor involved. We always give you transparent pricing information.

Q: What does the warranty cover?
A: Our workmanship is covered for as long as you own the vehicle. Parts carry the manufacturer's warranty.

Q: How do I get to the shop?
A: There's no access to the business from Independence Blvd. Enter from Four Lakes Dr off Independence Point Pkwy. Google Maps works best.
